method: Broker symbol metadata (digits, point, tick size/value, contract size, volume min/max/step, trade mode, filling mode) hashed per cycle over the live shadow runtime; any drift blocks the engine (METADATA_DRIFT_BLOCKED).
note: The independent probe hash uses trade_contract_size field naming (MT5 native); the runtime hash uses the R2 resolver's normalized contract_size key. Both are internally stable; the runtime baseline is the authority for drift detection.
blocking_rule: metadata change -> METADATA_DRIFT_BLOCKED, no strategy evaluation
